target_contract: EXPLORE/TRAIN -> adaptive TUNE/SELECTION -> immutable CERTIFY with valid candidate-local sequential evidence -> untouched OUTER/REPORT

positive_evidence: Candidate mutations are isolated in a Git worktree and freeze_candidate commits them before acceptance evaluation.
Candidate evaluation must bind the exact frozen worktree HEAD and rejects uncommitted post-freeze changes.

The sealed suite must live outside the repository and candidate worktree, declare historical_outputs_reused=false, candidate_access=forbidden, one_shot_release_evaluation=true, paired_baseline_candidate=true, and complete paired case coverage.
Acceptance/sealed results require controller-side HMAC attestation; approval is signed and bound to the candidate commit.
Promotion rechecks the candidate commit and atomically updates release and active Git refs; rollback is restricted to frozen release refs.
gaps: The decisive sealed_test is itself used by approve/promote, so it is CERTIFY/admission data, not an untouched OUTER surface.
The gate is fixed-sample mean plus normal 95% interval and deterministic non-regression/cost rules; no candidate-local anytime-valid e-process or confidence-sequence implementation was found.
No cross-candidate online FDR/FWER/alpha-wealth ledger was found.

Although PHASE_ORDER names training, proposal_selection, acceptance_validation, and sealed_test, exact-revision code search did not find a mandatory orchestration path invoking proposal_selection or acceptance_validation; the tested core promotion path can freeze and go directly to sealed_test.
No source-bound evidence proves a zero-pre-terminal-query OUTER surface unused by promotion, rollback, routing, stopping, or recovery.

positive_evidence: Each generation starts from an immutable baseline, runs training, collects candidates, reviews them, and evaluates promoted skill/strategy trees against baseline on a separate validation manifest.
Grasp-strategy evolution separates a train-derived canary comparison from a validation-manifest held-out comparison before accepting the strategy for the next generation.
Generation artifacts preserve baseline hashes, candidate manifests, validation baseline/candidate results, and next-generation baseline state.
gaps: The same validation/held-out surface is used for promotion in every generation; it is an adaptive admission surface, not untouched OUTER.
Promotion uses deterministic no-regression/success-count rules, not anytime-valid candidate-local statistical evidence or cross-candidate spending.
The provided six-task train and holdout manifests repeat the same six task identities with seed0 versus seed1, so the example holdout is seed-level rather than task-level generalization.

The provided parallel_libero_eval example overlaps the train/holdout task family and includes a task identity used in the six-task train/holdout examples; it is not source-bound as a pristine post-selection outer lockbox for iterate.

design_update.rule: Evaluation surface names are not evidence of isolation; prove enforced consumption topology from executable call paths, suite identity, and tests.
minimum_surface_record: first_query event and total query count
whether results or identities are released to proposer
whether surface influences promotion, rollback, routing, stopping, recovery, or checkpoint selection
statistical method and its actual sampling assumptions
outer_preterminal_query_count, required to equal zero for OUTER

exact_next_action: Search for an executable open-source system that combines OphAgent-like immutable candidate/sealed-suite enforcement with LOGOS-like candidate-local anytime-valid CERTIFY, durable cross-candidate statistical accounting, and a separate OUTER surface whose pre-terminal query count is provably zero. Prioritize code/tests that enforce the four-surface call graph rather than merely naming phases; next inspect systems with explicit third test/report manifests and sequential gates, and revisit LOGOS/MAAF only if public code appears.
